summary: Greenfield `gh plate bootstrap --apply` writes the template payload and initial `.plate` in one Git commit instead of one commit per file.
migration_impact: New repositories bootstrapped with plate-core after this change show a single grouped scaffold commit on the default branch (plus the existing optional initial README commit on empty repos). Stale-skip reporting and label sync behavior are unchanged.
agent_notes: When reviewing bootstrap history on a repo, expect one commit titled "Bootstrap: initialize PLATE template payload" for scaffold files rather than dozens of per-path commits. Re-run bootstrap still skips identical and stale remote paths per #1257.
